text: We were sold on the Salesforce sync and it has never worked reliably. Six months of workarounds. The support team try hard but they cannot fix what engineering will not prioritise.
Setup took an afternoon and the CSV importer just worked. The reporting is where it really earns its keep - I build the exec pack in ten minutes now instead of a day.
It's fine. Does the job. The mobile app is basically unusable though, everything is tiny and half the filters are missing.
Genuinely the best tool we bought last year. Anna in support answered a Sunday night question in eleven minutes.
Too expensive for what it is. We are paying enterprise money for something that times out whenever we pull more than a quarter of data.
Solid. Would be a 10 if the API had proper pagination and webhook retries. Right now I maintain a cron job to paper over it.
Onboarding was a mess. We were handed to three different people, none of whom knew what the last one had agreed, and the migration scripts we were promised never appeared.
No complaints really. The UI got busier in the redesign and I liked the old nav better, but I got used to it.
Down twice in a month during our busiest week. I do not care how good the features are if I cannot log in.
The audit log alone justifies the cost for us - our compliance review went from three weeks to two days.
The product is good but the price increase at renewal was 40% with two weeks notice. That is not how you treat a customer who has been here four years.
Fast, clean, does exactly what it says. Onboarding call was genuinely useful rather than a sales pitch.
Cannot export to anything our finance team uses. No Xero, no Sage, and the CSV column names change between releases so my macros break.
Love it overall. The one thing I would change is bulk editing - selecting 200 records one at a time is soul destroying.
Works well on desktop. On an iPad it is a broken website in an app wrapper. We do field work so that matters more than you would think.
Awful. Lost two days of entries after your migration and nobody could tell me where they went. Still waiting on an explanation.
Support is the differentiator. The product is comparable to the alternatives but I get a human who understands my setup within the hour.
Does what we need. A bit slow loading the main dashboard first thing in the morning, presumably everyone logs in at once.
We use maybe 20% of it and pay for all of it. Would like a lighter plan. Also the permissions model is confusing - I still cannot work out why some people see the archive.
Switched from a competitor and the migration support was excellent. Everything landed intact and the team were on a call for the cutover.
n/a
Reporting is strong, integrations are weak. If you connect to Slack and Jira you are fine; anything else and you are writing code.
Unreliable. Third outage this quarter. My team has lost confidence and two of them have gone back to spreadsheets.
The new keyboard shortcuts are a lovely touch. Whoever spent time on that, thank you.
Fine tool, painful setup. Took us nine weeks to go live because the SSO configuration is not documented anywhere I could find.
